description:
`src/fetcher/reddit.cr:17` hardcodes the project version inside the User-Agent string:

```crystal
USER_AGENT = "fetcher.cr/0.9.7 (https://github.com/kritoke/fetcher.cr; 3081486+kritoke@users.noreply.github.com)"
```

But `shard.yml` is at `0.9.21` and the most recent commit on main is `chore: release 0.9.21`. The User-Agent will silently lie about the version on every release until someone manually edits this string.

The string is also used in `src/fetcher/reddit_oauth.cr:77` so both sites need to stay in sync.

Action:
1. Add `Fetcher::VERSION` constant (e.g. in a new `src/fetcher/version.cr`) sourced from `shard.yml` or a hardcoded constant that mirrors it. Define a single source of truth.
2. Rewrite `USER_AGENT` to interpolate `Fetcher::VERSION` (or `Fetcher::USER_AGENT` itself uses the constant).
3. Document in a comment that `shard.yml` and the constant must be bumped together at release time (or use a release script to grep for the old version and replace it).

Acceptance: the User-Agent returned by Reddit reports the actual project version; no other behavior change; specs pass.
title: Fix stale hardcoded USER_AGENT version in reddit.cr
